image_alt: A whippet walks along a wide forest track with golden bracken and autumn trees on either side.

text.facebook: The deer rut is on. The RSPCA has asked dog walkers to keep dogs under close control around wildlife in breeding season, and in the Forest of Dean that means fallow bucks. Deer are most active at dawn and dusk. My tip: if you hear grunting in the trees, clip the lead on and turn round, deer or boar. More on walking safely through the rut: https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/deer-rut-and-dogs
